name: Armilla
description: An armillary sphere flattened onto the page: two rings crossing at a pole.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 4%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 80%, #000 80%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 80%, #000 80%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 32%; top: 4%; width: 36%; height: 92%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 68%, #000 68%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 68%, #000 68%); -webkit-transform: rotate(@pick(-24deg, 0deg, 24deg)); transform: rotate(@pick(-24deg, 0deg, 24deg)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
